attributes.additional_details:
We as the public want a General Election held now as the whole of the labour party let this country down not just Keir Starmer and electing another without an entire UK vote is again another shady tactic of the already untrustworthy labour government.

We want a General Election now stop ignoring us. We will rise up if this goes unheard.
attributes.background:
It not just two tier keir Starmer that has fail us countless times these past two years it is the whole party. 

We as the public need a general election now that starmer has stepped down as the leader, appointing another labour MP is going from the frying pan into the fire.
